messages:
helen: Hey team — Acme Cloud asked for an integration plan covering SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, KMS/HSM support, and secrets manager connectors. Want owners & a minimal pilot checklist.

sam: I can take SAML + KMS/HSM security acceptance. Need their IdP metadata and any required attributes (e.g., email, groups, entitlements).

raj: I'll own SCIM + secrets manager connectors (they use HashiCorp Vault + GCP Secret Manager). Need a staging Vault instance and test secrets.

maria: I'll help with connector QA — especially Vault token lifecycle and lease renewals. Also watch for role-based access mapping.

olivia: Legal here. We need to craft a short addendum for customer-managed keys + a PCN for secrets access. Also confirm publicity window for a joint blog/webinar.

helen: High-level pilot proposal: Week 0 (prep): exchange metadata & staging creds. Week 1: SAML login flows + SCIM provisioning. Week 2: KMS integration + secrets connector + security review. Week 3: optional announcement prep. Agree?

sam: Sounds good. For SAML: confirm SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated flows, ACS URLs, NameID format. Also request their cert in PEM. Sample SP metadata we provide:```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://redwood.example/ssp\">...</EntityDescriptor>
```

raj: SCIM details: we support POST /Users, PATCH for delta, PUT for full replace, and /Groups. Ask Acme whether they prefer delta (PATCH) deltas and incremental provisioning. Example PATCH payload:```json
[{\"op\":\"add\",\"path\":\"groups\",\"value\":[\"eng\"]}]
```

maria: Important: SCIM rate limits will be 60 req/min by default for partner pilots. We can raise if they need. Also we log SCIM changes for 90 days for audits.

sam: KMS: they want HSM-backed keys for customer-managed keys. If they bring their own HSM, we need an attestation step and a plugin for key wrapping. For AWS KMS, we accept CMKs with a role binding like:```json
{\"Statement\":[{\"Effect\":\"Allow\",\"Principal\":{\"AWS\":\"arn:aws:iam::ACME:role/RedwoodIntegration\"},\"Action\":[\"kms:Encrypt\",\"kms:Decrypt\",\"kms:GenerateDataKey\"]}]}
```

raj: Secrets manager connectors: plan is two-phase: 1) read-only fetch of secrets for runtime (no writes) 2) optional rotation integration. For Vault, we'll use AppRole auth in staging. Sample cURL to read a secret:```bash
curl -H \"X-Vault-Token: s.XXXX\" https://vault.staging/acme/data/myapp
```

olivia: Legal note: if we store references to customer-managed keys or secrets we need to clarify responsibility lines in the addendum. I'll draft and share by EOD tomorrow.

helen: Ops question: do we allow secrets to flow through Redwood runtime or do we support passthrough (never persist)?

maria: For the pilot we'll do ephemeral passthrough + in-memory only. No persistence. We'll document memory TTL and zeroing behavior.

sam: Checklist for me: SAML cert rotation plan, metadata URL, signed assertions requirement, audit event hooks for failed logins, KMS key policy template, HSM attestation checklist.

raj: Checklist for SCIM/secrets: staging service account, sample users + groups JSON, Vault AppRole creds, list of secrets to try (names + versions). I'll also prepare an automated test script.

integrations-bot: TODO created: \"Provision staging Vault + service account\" assigned to raj (due 48h).

nate: tagging infra — FIPS/TLS requirement? If Acme needs FIPS endpoints for token exchange we need a ticket.

helen: Acme's security pref says FIPS TLS for KMS calls and SCIM endpoints (not sure if mandatory). We should flag risk for timeline.

nate: I'll open infra ticket and estimate 72h for FIPS-enabled staging endpoints.

olivia: Webinar: Acme proposed ~3 weeks, but given infra + pilot we should mark the announcement tentative and set \"announce if pilot complete by\" date instead.

sam: One more technical: SCIM attribute mapping for groups -> we should expose claim mapping: groups -> membership claim in SAML to maintain sync consistency.

raj: I'll add a small mapping doc and a sample mapping YAML for their IdP. Example:```yaml
scim:groups: SAML.groups
scim:userName: SAML.email
```

helen: Good. Can we have the initial pilot email to Acme drafted today? I can send it. Include: API endpoints (staging), metadata URLs, sample user list template, expected pilot timeline, and ask for FIPS/non-FIPS preference.

olivia: I'll CC legal and PR on the outbound. Also request a security contact for attestation docs.

helen: Perfect. I'll draft and send. Reconvene in 48h for infra & creds update. :rocket:
